<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="description" content="Shape Up with Gabby is a fitness app for women with gym and home workout plans, nutrition tracking, classes and a supportive community.">
<meta name="rating" content="general">
<title>Shape Up with Gabby | Training, nutrition and community in one app</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@300;500;700&family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ===== Tokens (map these to Elementor Global Colours / Fonts) ===== */
:root{
  --su-ink:#121212;
  --su-body:#3d3d3d;
  --su-muted:#7a7a7a;
  --su-yellow:#FDE08D;
  --su-cream:#FFF7DD;
  --su-blue:#62BAF5;
  --su-blue-soft:#EAF4FE;
  --su-blue-line:#9FD2F8;
  --su-white:#ffffff;
  --su-head:'Oswald','Arial Narrow',Arial,sans-serif;
  --su-text:'Poppins',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;
  --su-wrap:1180px;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 90px)}
body{margin:0;background:#fff;color:var(--su-ink);font-family:var(--su-text);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--su-blue);outline-offset:3px}
.su-wrap{max-width:var(--su-wrap);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}

/* Headings: light line + bold line */
.su-h2{font-family:var(--su-head);text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,58px);line-height:1.02;margin:0;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:-.5px}
.su-h2 strong{font-weight:700;display:block}
.su-h2 b{font-weight:700}
.su-eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--su-muted);margin:0 0 14px}
.su-intro{max-width:300px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--su-ink);margin:0}
.su-head-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:32px;margin-bottom:48px}

/* Buttons */
.su-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border-radius:999px;font-family:var(--su-text);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;padding:15px 34px;border:1.5px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s ease}
.su-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.su-btn--blue{background:var(--su-blue);color:#fff}
.su-btn--yellow{background:var(--su-yellow);color:var(--su-ink)}
.su-btn--outline{background:#fff;border-color:var(--su-ink);color:var(--su-ink)}
.su-btn--ghost{background:#fff;border-color:#cfcfcf;color:var(--su-ink)}

/* ===== Header ===== */
.su-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;padding:12px 24px 0;margin-bottom:-90px}
.su-nav{max-width:1220px;margin:0 auto;background:rgba(255,253,245,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(180,150,60,.12);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 10px 10px 28px}
.su-logo img{height:26px;width:auto}
.su-nav ul{list-style:none;display:flex;gap:30px;margin:0;padding:0}
.su-nav ul a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
.su-nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.su-login{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;color:var(--su-ink)}
.su-burger{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--su-yellow);border:0;cursor:pointer;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.su-burger span{display:block;width:16px;height:2px;background:var(--su-ink);box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--su-ink),0 -5px 0 var(--su-ink)}
.su-mobile-menu{display:none}

/* ===== Hero ===== */
.su-hero{position:relative;background:radial-gradient(60% 55% at 62% 30%,#FFE9A8 0%,rgba(255,240,190,0) 70%),linear-gradient(180deg,#FFF6D9 0%,#FFFBEE 70%,#fff 100%);padding:150px 0 0;overflow:hidden}
.su-hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;align-items:center;gap:20px;min-height:560px}
.su-rating{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
.su-avatars{display:flex}
.su-avatars img{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff;object-fit:cover;margin-left:-7px}
.su-avatars img:first-child{margin-left:0}
.su-stars{color:#F6C21B;letter-spacing:1px}
.su-hero h1{font-family:var(--su-head);font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(40px,5.6vw,66px);line-height:1;margin:22px 0 16px;letter-spacing:-.3px}
.su-hero p.lead{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 28px;max-width:430px}
.su-hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.su-hero-note{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.4px;color:var(--su-muted);margin-top:18px;text-transform:uppercase}
.su-hero-art{position:relative;height:580px}
.su-hero-gabby{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-20px;height:600px;width:auto;z-index:1}
.su-phone{background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--su-blue);border-radius:30px;padding:5px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(60,120,170,.18);overflow:hidden}
.su-phone img{border-radius:24px;width:100%;height:auto}
.su-hero-phone1{position:absolute;width:220px;left:250px;top:70px;transform:rotate(-4deg);z-index:3}
.su-hero-phone2{position:absolute;width:190px;left:390px;top:20px;transform:rotate(-6deg);z-index:2}

/* Stats ticker */
.su-ticker{position:relative;z-index:4;margin-top:-30px;height:110px}
.su-ticker::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:30px -20px 20px;background:var(--su-yellow);transform:rotate(-1deg)}
.su-ticker-band{position:absolute;left:-30px;right:-30px;top:20px;background:var(--su-blue);transform:rotate(-3deg);overflow:hidden;padding:14px 0;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.su-ticker-track{display:flex;gap:46px;width:max-content;animation:su-marquee 32s linear infinite;color:#fff;font-size:17px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;align-items:center}
.su-ticker-track b{font-weight:700}
.su-ticker-track .spark{color:#FFE08A;font-size:22px}
@keyframes su-marquee{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ===== What Shape Up is ===== */
.su-about{padding:70px 0 120px;position:relative}
.su-about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;align-items:center}
.su-about p{max-width:400px;font-size:14.5px;margin:0 0 14px}
.su-about p.sub{color:var(--su-body)}
.su-about .su-h2{margin-bottom:26px}
.su-facts{display:flex;gap:36px;margin-top:40px}
.su-facts strong{display:block;font-family:var(--su-head);font-size:24px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.1}
.su-facts span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.3px;color:var(--su-muted);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase}
.su-about-phones{position:relative;height:500px}
.su-about-phones .a{position:absolute;width:200px;left:12%;top:60px}
.su-about-phones .b{position:absolute;width:220px;left:40%;top:0;z-index:2}

/* Wave divider helper */
.su-wave{display:block;width:100%;height:70px}

/* ===== What's inside (app spotlight) ===== */
.su-fx{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--su-blue-soft) 0%,var(--su-blue-soft) 90%,#fff 100%);padding:50px 0 100px}
.su-fx-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:70px;align-items:center}
.su-fx-intro{font-size:14.5px;max-width:420px;margin:18px 0 30px}
.su-fx-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.su-fx-item{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.su-fx-item button{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;cursor:pointer;display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr 24px;align-items:center;padding:18px 0;font-family:var(--su-head);font-size:22px;font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6f7d8a;transition:color .2s}
.su-fx-item button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--su-blue);outline-offset:2px}
.su-fx-item .ic{font-size:22px;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.5;transition:all .2s}
.su-fx-item .pl{font-family:var(--su-text);font-size:20px;font-weight:400;transition:transform .2s}
.su-fx-item p{margin:0;max-height:0;overflow:hidden;font-size:14px;color:var(--su-body);padding-left:44px;transition:max-height .35s ease,padding .35s ease}
.su-fx-item.on button{color:var(--su-ink)}
.su-fx-item.on .ic{filter:none;opacity:1}
.su-fx-item.on .pl{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.su-fx-item.on p{max-height:120px;padding-bottom:18px}
.su-fx-stage{position:relative;height:620px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.su-fx-stage::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:440px;height:440px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--su-yellow)}
.su-fx-stage .su-phone{position:relative;width:280px;z-index:2}
.su-fx img{transition:opacity .3s}
.su-fx-chip{position:absolute;z-index:3;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(40,90,140,.15);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.su-fx-chip span{font-size:18px}
.su-fx-chip.c1{top:110px;left:20px}.su-fx-chip.c2{bottom:120px;right:10px}
.su-fx-cta{margin-top:30px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.su-fx-cta small{font-size:12px;color:var(--su-muted)}
.su-fx-tabs,.su-fx-panel{display:none}

/* ===== Inside the app ===== */
.su-app{padding:90px 0 110px}
.su-app-phones{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;margin:30px 0 48px}
.su-app-phones .su-phone{width:166px;flex:0 0 auto;margin-top:70px}
.su-app-phones .su-phone:nth-child(2),.su-app-phones .su-phone:nth-child(4){margin-top:30px}
.su-app-phones .su-phone:nth-child(3){margin-top:0}
.su-pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:10px;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto}
.su-pill{border:1.5px solid var(--su-blue-line);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 18px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500}
.su-pill:nth-child(odd){background:#D6ECFD}
.su-pill i{font-style:normal;margin-right:6px}

/* ===== Pricing ===== */
.su-pricing{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--su-cream) 0%,var(--su-cream) 88%,#fff 100%);padding:30px 0 70px;text-align:center}
.su-pricing .su-h2 strong{display:inline}
.su-pricing .lede{max-width:470px;margin:14px auto 46px;font-size:14px}
.su-plans{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;text-align:left}
.su-plan{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid #F4E3A8;border-radius:16px;overflow:visible;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.su-plan .ph{height:180px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:15px 15px 0 0}
.su-plan .ph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.su-plan .bd{padding:18px 16px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
.su-plan .term{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.6px;color:var(--su-muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.su-plan .price{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;margin:4px 0 8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.su-plan .price b{font-family:var(--su-head);font-size:40px;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.su-plan .price span{font-size:11px}
.su-plan .day{align-self:flex-start;background:var(--su-yellow);border-radius:999px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;padding:4px 10px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:16px}
.su-plan .su-btn{width:100%;padding:12px}
.su-plan .desc{border-top:1px solid #ddd;margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;text-align:center;font-size:13px}
.su-plan--pop{background:var(--su-yellow);border-color:var(--su-yellow)}
.su-plan--pop .term{color:var(--su-ink)}
.su-plan--pop .day{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--su-ink)}
.su-plan--pop .su-btn{background:#fff}
.su-plan--pop .desc{border-color:rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.su-plan .badge{position:absolute;top:-10px;left:18px;z-index:2;background:#fff;border-radius:999px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.3px;padding:4px 10px;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.su-ticks{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 24px;margin:28px 0 0;font-size:12px;list-style:none;padding:0}
.su-ticks li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.su-ticks li::before{content:"✓";display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--su-ink);color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:700}
.su-featured--hero{margin-top:34px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);max-width:440px}
.su-featured--hero p{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.8px;font-weight:600;color:var(--su-muted);text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 12px}
.su-featured--hero .logos{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.su-featured--hero img{height:22px;width:auto}
.su-featured--hero .wf{background:#000;padding:3px 7px;height:24px}

/* ===== Programmes ===== */
.su-progs{padding:70px 0 100px}
.su-prog-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:18px}
.su-arrows{display:flex;gap:10px}
.su-arrow{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--su-ink);background:#fff;font-size:22px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;padding-bottom:3px}
.su-arrow:hover{background:var(--su-yellow)}
.su-arrow:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default;background:#fff}
.su-prog-track{display:flex;gap:20px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-behavior:smooth;padding:4px max(24px,calc((100vw - var(--su-wrap))/2 + 24px)) 18px;scroll-padding-left:max(24px,calc((100vw - var(--su-wrap))/2 + 24px));scrollbar-width:none}
.su-prog-track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.su-pcard{flex:0 0 300px;scroll-snap-align:start}
.su-pcard .ph{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:#eee;margin-bottom:16px}
.su-pcard .ph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.su-pcard h3{font-family:var(--su-head);font-weight:500;font-size:20px;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 6px}
.su-pcard p:not(.su-meta){font-size:13px;color:var(--su-body);margin:0;line-height:1.5}
.su-pcard .play{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--su-blue);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:13px;border:0;cursor:pointer}
.su-tag{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;background:var(--su-yellow);font-family:var(--su-head);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.6px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:4px;text-transform:uppercase}
.su-meta{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:1.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--su-muted);text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 6px}
.su-compare{margin-top:30px;background:var(--su-blue);border-radius:14px;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:22px 22px 22px 22px}
.su-compare p{margin:0;font-size:15.5px;max-width:460px}

.su-oneoff-btn{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:14px}
.su-oneoff-btn .su-btn:hover{background:var(--su-yellow);border-color:var(--su-yellow)}

/* ===== Results ===== */
.su-results{padding:30px 0 80px}
.su-reviews{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:28px}
.su-review{border:1px solid #e3e3e3;border-radius:16px;padding:22px 18px}
.su-review .stars{color:#F6C21B;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px}
.su-review blockquote{margin:12px 0 14px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.45}
.su-review cite{font-style:normal;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:1.3px;font-weight:600;color:var(--su-muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.su-videos-h{font-family:var(--su-head);font-weight:500;font-size:20px;text-transform:uppercase;margin:46px 0 14px}

.su-story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1fr);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--su-yellow)}
.su-story .ph{position:relative;background:#fff;min-height:460px}
.su-story .ph img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 30%}
.su-story .txt{padding:34px 34px 30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.su-story .stars{color:#fff;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2px}
.su-story h3{font-family:var(--su-head);font-weight:700;font-size:30px;text-transform:uppercase;margin:10px 0 18px;line-height:1.05}
.su-story .stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:22px}
.su-story .stats div{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 12px 10px}
.su-story .stats b{display:block;font-family:var(--su-head);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.su-story .stats span{font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.3;display:block;margin-top:4px}
.su-story blockquote{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.45}
.su-story .extra{margin:0;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5}
.su-story cite{font-style:normal;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.4px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:auto;padding-top:20px}
.lbl{position:absolute;top:12px;z-index:2;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:4px;text-transform:uppercase}
.lbl.b{left:12px;background:var(--su-yellow);color:var(--su-ink)}
.lbl.a{left:calc(50% + 10px);background:var(--su-blue);color:#fff}
.su-tf-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;margin-top:46px;margin-bottom:14px}
.su-tf-head .su-videos-h{margin:0}
.su-tf-track{display:flex;gap:14px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-behavior:smooth;padding:0 max(24px,calc((100vw - var(--su-wrap))/2 + 24px)) 6px;scroll-padding-left:max(24px,calc((100vw - var(--su-wrap))/2 + 24px));scrollbar-width:none}
.su-tf-track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.su-tf{position:relative;flex:0 0 340px;aspect-ratio:1/1;margin:0;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:#f3f3f3;scroll-snap-align:start}
.su-tf img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

/* ===== Meet Gabby ===== */
.su-gabby{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,var(--su-cream) 12%,var(--su-cream) 88%,#fff 100%);padding:90px 0}
.su-gabby-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.05fr;gap:44px;align-items:center}
.su-gabby-ph{position:relative}
.su-gabby-ph img{border-radius:14px;width:100%;height:560px;object-fit:contain;background:#FAFAFA}
.su-gabby-ph .note{position:absolute;left:-8px;bottom:-8px;background:var(--su-yellow);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;max-width:150px;line-height:1.35}
.su-gabby .su-eyebrow{color:var(--su-ink)}
.su-gabby .su-h2{font-size:clamp(34px,4.5vw,48px);margin-bottom:18px}
.su-gabby p{font-size:13.5px;margin:0 0 12px}
.su-creds{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin:22px 0 30px;max-width:430px}
.su-creds .ic{font-size:18px}
.su-creds b{display:block;font-family:var(--su-head);font-size:19px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.2}
.su-creds span{font-size:10px;line-height:1.35;display:block;color:var(--su-body)}
.su-insta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid #e4d6a8;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 18px;background:#FFFBEF;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase}

/* ===== FAQ ===== */
.su-faq{padding:60px 0 60px}
.su-faq-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px}
.su-faq-side p{font-size:12.5px;margin:12px 0 22px;max-width:260px}
.su-faq-side a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:2px solid var(--su-yellow)}
